artifacts.command:
[".venv/bin/python", "-c", "import json,re
from pathlib import Path
from tiny_perceptron.data import ByteTokenizer
from scripts.course_experiments.applications import _prompt_ids
r=json.loads(Path('docs/course-experiments/results/rag.json').read_text())['results'];tok=ByteTokenizer()
for mode in ['correct_with_distractor','distractor_only']:
 rows=[x for x in r['samples'] if x['mode']==mode];counts={'valid':0,'supported':0,'fact_correct':0}
 for x in rows:
  g=x['generation'];s=g['samples'][0];ids=s['generated_ids'];assert _prompt_ids(g['messages'],tok)==g['input_ids'];assert tok.decode(ids)==s['generated'];assert ids[-1]==2 and s['eos'];text=s['generated'];m=re.fullmatch(r'([ABCD][0-9])\[(D[0-9])\]',text);a,c=m.groups() if m else (None,None);source=next((d for d in x['documents'] if d['id']==c),None);valid=bool(m and source);support=bool(valid and 'address='+a in source['text']);correct=bool(m and a==x['fact']['address'] and c==x['fact']['source']);counts['valid']+=valid;counts['supported']+=support;counts['fact_correct']+=correct
  print(mode,x['family'],repr(text),'valid',valid,'supported',support,'fact_correct',correct)
 print(mode,counts,'denominator',len(rows))"]
